title: Full count below a threshold
statement: Let $kf:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ and let $N,K\in\mathbb{N}$. If $kf(i)<K$ for every $i<N$, then exactly $N$ indices among $0,\ldots,N-1$ satisfy $kf(i)<K$.
